text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's not a bad result at all.
I made it onto the board, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's kind of like my reliable spot.
Or more like, it's pretty much my reserved seat now.
choice_data_list: You should be prouder of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's kind of like my reliable spot.
Or more like, it's pretty much my reserved seat now.
choice_data_list: You should be prouder of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's not really something to boast about.
It's not like I won or anything.
choice_data_list: It's proof of your true strength. You'll definitely win next time!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa... It's amazing how you can just look me in the eye and say 'definitely.'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, seeing as their Trainer
looks pretty confident and all?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
While I wouldn't say it's guaranteed,
betting on the possibility doesn't sound half bad either.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with the hardcore boot camp vibe?!
I've told you before, I can't deal with that stuff~
choice_data_list: So, are you okay with leaving it like this?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...As if that could be okay.
You know that full well.
choice_data_list: Then let's do our best next time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Trainer, you always love making me say it~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...If I win next time,
you're not allowed to make me say it, got it?!"
